review_notes: I read the whole file. It has two theorems about semisimple points and two about unipotent points. It declares no simp lemmas, definitions or attributes, and it makes no orientation choices. The proof of `isSemisimplePoint_of_pow_eq_one` uses `simpa only [map_pow, map_one, Comodule.pointsRepresentation_apply]`. I checked that `Comodule.pointsRepresentation_apply` is already tagged `@[simp]` in TauCeti/Algebra/Coalgebra/Comodule/PointsAction.lean. The other proofs are terms. The main results are existence-style implications, not rewrite identities, so I did not recommend simp attributes for them. I did not see a missing canonical simp lemma, competing rules, unwanted expansion or a plausible rewrite cycle. I did not read the imported Semisimple files in depth, so I cannot rule out simp-interface problems there. Those are outside this file.
